description: Source code for a Windows-specific utility that inspects PE files to list their dependencies (DLLs). It includes functions to load libraries, retrieve import descriptors, and print dependencies, along with license information.

methods.name: getLastErrorString
methods.description: Retrieves the last error message as a string.

methods.name: getDependencies
methods.description: Analyzes a loaded module to extract its import dependencies (DLLs).

methods.name: printDependencies
methods.description: Loads a specified library and prints its dependencies.

methods.name: printUsage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments and invokes dependency printing.
